verdicts.reason: A and B look pixel-identical. Both keep the original layout and just centre it vertically on the slightly taller canvas, which suits such a small change in aspect ratio. Brand, hierarchy (headline then CTA), the circle/can art and the alignment of the text column all survive intact. Leftover flaws in both: the two badges still compete visually with the CTA, the right ~15% of the canvas is unused dead space, and the 'SOLSTICE' label on the can is small.
